facts.fact: Togo's Ministry of Territorial Administration began training sessions on 28 August 2025, running to 5 September, for communal civil-registry officials as part of a reform to improve the collection and use of civil-registration statistics, with UNFPA and INSEED as partners.
The training sessions cover keeping registers and the quality indicators of vital statistics, according to the Ministry of Territorial Administration.
